test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 08 Jul, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: The marked price of a battery - operated rickshaw is Rs. 90,000. It is available for sale at two successive discounts of 10% and 5%. What is the selling price (in Rs.) of the battery - operated rickshaw?
solution:
**Given:**

The marked price of a battery-operated rickshaw = ₹90,000

First discount = 10%

Second discount = 5%

**Formula used:**

Selling Price after successive discounts = Marked Price × (1 - First Discount) × (1 - Second Discount)</p
